items.summary: Update the app’s visual theme to a cohesive gray + purple palette (replacing the current black/blue liquid-glass palette) by adjusting the Tailwind/CSS design tokens so that surfaces, borders, text, and primary/accent colors render as gray-forward with purple highlights across Home, options pages, dialogs, checkout, and order confirmation.

Enforce MGP ID format validation everywhere the user enters an MGP ID (Gen 4 Racer dialog and Gen 5 Racer dialog): the value must start with the literal prefix "mgp-" and be followed by digits only (any length, any numeric sequence).

Change the MGP ID confirm flow so that after the user enters a valid MGP ID and confirms, the app navigates directly to the existing checkout page (/checkout) instead of showing a success/accepted panel; pass the selected model in router search params so the checkout header shows the correct model.
